implementation: Default-off mode1 uses preparation/state and output streams; mode2 uses three streams. Preparation includes original normalization,V/beta conversion,gate scan,KKT,inverse,WU and paired scores. Three independent1024-token storage slots preserve original A/W,inverse/Vnew,V/U aliases and wait for the prior output before reuse. State always remains on one ordered stream; output waits for that segment state. An input event covers caller writes/seed, and the final consumer is joined and completed before return. Windows contain at most eight original segments; partialK64 tails retain neutral padding and the completed prefix state. Checkpoints and capture/diagnostic paths retain the original schedule. All kernels,K16 arithmetic and BF16 endpoints stay unchanged. Additional persistent storage179945472bytes is prepared during provider load and is included in the memory query even after the route is disabled. Partial failures drain every stream before caller storage can be released.
correctness_scope: Host production-owner dependency graphs cover640 eligibility cases,ten schedules,six partial submission failures and four event-allocation failures; ASan/UBSan also cover original seeded windows,logical tails,checkpoint fallback and allocation reporting across route/compatibility/diagnostic modes. Initial host fixture and source-extractor errors are retained. The initial source passes nine native probes including64/65/1025 boundaries and all three modes at7169/8192. The corrected memory-only revision adds four native checks, including captured7169 and8192 with the final DLL. Every output and final FP32 state bit matches the qualified canonical original provider, and synchronous/asynchronous calls match. The7169 inputs carry the existing original GB10 exact-output/state audit. The8192 fixture is generated and does not establish real-model correctness. The q65 observer initially expected one segment per call instead of the aligned prefix plus separate tail; its native test passed and was accepted only after the recorded offline observer correction. No GPU rerun was needed for that observer correction.
timing_scope: Only bounded process walls and maximum completed phase intervals are attached. They include fixture work, original reference execution and setup; they are not isolated throughput or model TTFT and do not establish a retained gain. Full real-model OFF/ON comparisons are pending.
decision: The provider is eligible for correctness-attached real-model comparison. Retain defaults off and the qualified23353.80795ms model control until fresh model runs establish both the GB10 boundary and a measured benefit. Native component success alone does not qualify release.
